ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Scripts Installed as Services
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects powershell script installed as a Service Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*pwsh.*")))
